alanagoyal/branded:stripe:node-v23-0-0: The repo uses stripe-node 15.12.0, so nothing breaks until the SDK is upgraded. v23 is the SDK major that pins Endive. The removed items (constructEventWithoutVerification, the ErrorType export, V1 fields on V2List) do not appear in the usage map; the repo uses no v2 APIs. Two parts do touch this repo: constructEvent verification and the new StripeConnectionError on truncated bodies. The jump from 15 to 23 also crosses v16–v22, each with its own breaking typings and pinned-version changes. The migration agent should step through those changelogs. It should also confirm the webhook route reads the raw text body and that error handling around stripe calls doesn't depend on ErrorType.
alanagoyal/branded:stripe:2026-09-30-endive-api-version: Endive is a breaking API major. The repo is implicitly pinned through stripe-node 15.12.0's built-in version, so it only hits Endive when it upgrades the SDK or the webhook endpoint version. None of the specific Endive breaking items (payment_method_types, billing_cycle_anchor, Financial Connections, Connect, Reserves, Stripe.js) match a recorded call site. Impact is low, but the upgrade path from a 2024-era version to Endive also crosses the Basil, Clover and Dahlia majors. The migration agent should review all of them for customers, subscriptions, checkout sessions, billing portal and subscription schedules. It should also check the webhook endpoint's api_version in the Dashboard.
alanagoyal/branded:stripe:node-v23-drop-node18: The repo's Node runtime version is not in the usage map. If it deploys on Node 18 (Vercel project setting, engines field or .nvmrc), upgrading to stripe-node v23 would be unsupported. The migration agent should check the engines field, .nvmrc and the Vercel Node version before bumping the SDK.
alanagoyal/branded:stripe:node-v23-webhook-tolerance: This only changes behaviour if the route passes an explicit tolerance (especially 0) or calls signature.verifyHeader directly. The usage map shows constructEvent, probably with the default tolerance, so impact is likely none. The migration agent should confirm no tolerance argument is passed when upgrading to v23.
alanagoyal/branded:stripe:node-23-1-0-endive-oct: The repo only lists subscription schedules, probably to release or cancel them during account deletion. The required pause_schedules field is a typing change, and the 2026-10-28.endive version is additive. Impact should be minimal on upgrade. The migration agent should check that any SubscriptionSchedule mocks or type constructions still compile.
alanagoyal/branded:stripe:runtime-node-22-drop: The repo uses stripe-node, but its Node runtime version is unknown. If it runs Node 20 or 22, future stripe-node majors will need a runtime upgrade. This is long-horizon and low impact. The migration agent should check the Vercel and engines Node version.
